title: Initial ambient representative of a supported perfect map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open and $T\subseteq X$ any subset. Use chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules on $X$, on every localized open site of $X$, on $U$, and on every localized open site of $U$, in one Hom universe. Let $E\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, let $F\in D(\mathcal O_U)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and assume all cohomology stalks of $F$ vanish at $x\in U$ with $x\notin T$. For every $\alpha:F\to E|_U$, there exist $R\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\beta:R\to E$ such that at every $x\in U$ the object $R$ has an open neighbourhood on which it is represented by a bounded complex of finite-free retracts, its cohomology stalks vanish at every $x\in U\setminus T$, and there is $e:R|_U\cong F$ with $\beta|_U=\alpha\circ e$. There is no condition on $R$ outside $U$.

proof.text: Compose the inverse of Modules.overEquiv U with the actual exact extension-by-zero functor of [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. Compose the adjunction with the inverse equivalence adjunction. The natural isomorphism of [lem-pc-open-extension-restriction-iso], whiskered with the equivalence functors, gives left-adjoint followed by restriction isomorphic to the identity. Apply the degreewise adjunction to cochain complexes and descend it through DerivedCategory.Q using Mathlib Adjunction.localization. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso give the same composite isomorphism in the derived categories. Mathlib fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId makes the derived left adjoint fully faithful, hence its adjunction unit is invertible. Define R as that concrete functor applied to F and beta as the adjoint transpose of alpha. Let e be the inverse unit component. Cancel the unit in homEquiv_unit to obtain the restriction equation.

Apply [lem-sc-open-perfect-model-transport] to R, F, the original perfectness hypothesis, and the restriction isomorphism e. This supplies precisely the local strictly perfect representatives at points of U; there is no condition outside U.

For each i and x in U, apply homology to e. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso compares exact restriction of homology with homology of restriction. Forget modules to abelian presheaves and apply the stalk functor. Modules.overFunctorEquiv U and Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι identify the stalk of the restricted homology with its ambient stalk. Their composite gives an additive equivalence between the ambient homology stalk and that of F at the corresponding point. Transport hFT along this equivalence using subsingleton_congr. This needs only the interior restriction comparison, not the extension-by-zero stalk-map theorem.

theorem exists_supported_map_initial_ambient_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (T : Set X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (hF : IsPerfect U.toScheme F)
    (hFT : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj F).val.presheaf x)))
    (α : F ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E.obj) :
    ∃ (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β : R ⟶ E.obj),
      (∀ x : X, x ∈ U → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ U → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∃ e : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅ F,
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map β = e.hom ≫ α
